author: Aether_Knight
what_it_is: Start new game with Free Play & Weapon Edit unlocked. Stage Select has 256 Loops accessible. BONUS ; Can play game with 99 lives! (DO NOT CHANGE LIVES IN OPTION MENU AND/OR SET OPTIONS TO DEFAULT!)
format: Max Drive / PowerSave save: 'Ps2PowerSave' header (CRC32 c8ef1703, matches), folder BASLUS-20712, 3 files, LZARI stream 4045 bytes unpacking to 36456 bytes (36340 bytes of file data)

title: GRADIUS V
SAVE DATA
save.times: none: a max file stores no file times

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/ps2-card.py 'gradius-v.19313.max' -o OUT: reads the save with mymcplus 3.0.5 and writes OUT/Mcd001.ps2 (an 8 MiB card with ECC, formatted and filled by mymcplus) for lrps2/pcee2/pcsx2, and OUT/mc0/<folder>/ for Play!

converted.read_back: work/ps2/tools/mcfs.py lists every file with the size and SHA-1 put on the card; one-saves (1saves convert + inspect) reads the card and finds BASLUS-20712
converted.timestamps: what the save does not date is 2000-01-01 00:00:00 (JST, as a card stores it); the card's own root entries too
